properties.name: Séítah dune complex (approximate)
properties.description: Large sand dunes and intervening ridges in the Séítah dune complex can impede rover mobility and create an entrapment hazard.
properties.caveat: Absence of a mapped hazard does not mean the terrain is safe. The outline is a simplified exterior of connected published large-aeolian-bedform polygons over Séítah-associated bedrock, including internal bedrock islands and adjoining dune tongues, with estimated overview-scale uncertainty of 250–500 m; it is used as an approximate scoring penalty, not a navigation boundary.

properties.name: Bagnold Dunes (approximate overview envelope)
properties.description: Loose active dune sand can cause wheel slip, sinkage, and loss of rover mobility.
properties.caveat: Absence of a mapped hazard does not mean the terrain is safe. This generalized envelope was manually traced from NASA MMGIS CTX tiles using a three-control-point affine transform, includes intervening bedrock gaps, and has estimated boundary uncertainty of 200-500 m, locally about 1 km; it is used as an approximate scoring penalty, not a navigation boundary.
